title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2/Maps
text:
These are the layouts of all nine levels of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater. Some levels have two versions: one with the collectibles and starting point marked out and one without said markers. Arrows on the markers indicate that the collectible is hiding behind or inside an obstruction.

The ones with the markers have the following:
 A blue chevron arrow for the starting potion and the direction in which the player will face.
 Green rectangles with a 100, 250, or 500 on them for spots with money.
 Yellow S-K-A-T-E letters for their locations.
 A VHS tape with a T on it for the secret tape's location.
 Two sets of custom items unique to some levels:
 Hangar: Gray barrels and gold pilot wing medals.
 School II: Orange hall passes with "HP" on them and brown bells.
 NY City: Red fire hydrants and bronze circles with a 1 for subway tokens.
 Venice: Pink spray paint cans and green jackets to signify where Ollie the Magic Bum spawns.
 Philadelphia: Gray liberty bells and an aqua valve to drain the fountain.
